Name: Farm Icons On Load Screen
Author: b1rdyw1rdy
Description:
[size=2]This mod displays the farm type icon on save files so that it is easier to know which farm is which. For old saves, you need to save the game once (end a day) in order for the icon to show up in the save file.

If there is an issue with the farm type in the save file, such as a modded farm type that has been changed or uninstalled, then the default farm icon will be displayed with an X through it.

In the config file, the size of the icons can be set to the default size, or a smaller size that makes the UI less crowded. I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] if you are interested in editing the config. If you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url] installed, you can click the cog button (⚙) on the main menu to get to the mod settings.
[/size]
